s: Pumped storage hydropower is often described as a ‘giant water battery’ because it primarily performs which function?

Stores electricity by moving water between reservoirs and generates power when required
Stores electricity permanently without any conversion losses
x: Pumped storage stores surplus electricity by pumping water to an upper reservoir and generates electricity when the water flows back through turbines. It is a long-duration storage system, not a permanent loss-free store.
